chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, who said:
Al-Fuḍayl asked him about forgetfulness, so he said: If you doubt concerning the first two rakʿahs, then repeat.

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent error in salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ: the first two rakʿahs of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer). It states that if a person doubts regarding the first two rakʿahs, the prayer must be repeated, highlighting the particular importance of certainty in the early units of the prayer.
